how_to_apply: Visit www.wbhealth.gov.in for the online application; only online applications will be accepted.

After successful payment, re-login and make the final submission of the application by 26/11/2026.

important_instructions: Application forms not properly filled in or incomplete are liable to be cancelled. content_sections.heading: About Rampurhat Health District
content_sections.text: The District Health & Family Welfare Samiti, Rampurhat Health District, works under the Office of the Chief Medical Officer of Health & Member-Secretary, Rampurhat Health District, Birbhum, within the Health & Family Welfare Department of the Government of West Bengal. This recruitment fills Community Health Assistant (Urban) posts under XVFC Health Grants and the National Urban Health Mission (NUHM) of National Health Mission, at an Urban Health and Wellness Centre (UHWC) and Urban Primary Health Centres (UPHC). The office can be reached at [email protected] or (03461) 297251.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 3 posts of Community Health Assistant (Urban) in two blocks, by programme: The XVFC Health Grants post is reserved for ST candidates. Of the two NUHM posts, one is UR (PwBD) and one is UR.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The same essential criteria apply to both blocks of posts. A candidate must meet all four conditions of one of the two options below. Candidate must have passed ANM course from an Institute recognised by the Indian Nursing Council. Candidate must be registered with the West Bengal Nursing Council. Candidate should be proficient in Bengali. Candidate should be permanent resident of Birbhum district. Candidate must have passed GNM course from an Institute recognised by the Indian Nursing Council. Candidate must be registered with the West Bengal Nursing Council. Candidate should be proficient in Bengali. Candidate should be permanent resident of Birbhum district. The age limit for both blocks of posts is minimum 21 years and maximum 40 years as on 1st January 2026. Age relaxation will be given for the reserved candidates as per govt. norms; the notice does not list the years of relaxation. Caste Certificate, Disability Certificate, EWS Certificate and similar certificates are accepted only when issued on or before the last date of online application by the competent authorities of West Bengal. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of each post.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is non-refundable. It can only be paid online through net banking, UPI payment or credit/debit card. Payment is made after registration using the application ID and Date of Birth, between 13/11/2026 and 23/11/2026. The notice asks candidates not to deposit the fee more than one time.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Rampurhat Health District Community Health Assistant (Urban)
content_sections.text: Visit www.wbhealth.gov.in for the online application; only online applications will be accepted. Complete the online registration between 13/11/2026 and 23/11/2026, accepting the pop-up that appears during the registration/application process. Upload a proper and full signature and photograph; an application without them will be treated as cancelled. Pay the application fee online using the application ID and Date of Birth, by 23/11/2026. After successful payment, re-login and make the final submission of the application by 26/11/2026. Download the hard copy/print copy of the online registration form from https://hr.wbhealth.gov.in and keep it for document verification. Do not send it by post. Keep the Online Registration Number for future reference; the employer is not liable to give any information about it later. Proper and full signature and photograph (uploaded during the online application) Printout of the online registration form (needed for original testimonials verification) Original testimonials, which must match the details given in the online application Caste / Disability / EWS Certificate issued by competent authorities of West Bengal, where applicable

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection for the Community Health Assistant (Urban) posts is on merit basis in the ANM/GNM examination. While preparing the score-sheet, marks will be calculated after rounding off up to 2 decimal points. The notice does not mention a written test or an interview. Candidates without the registration form will not be entertained for original testimonials verification. The selection panel will be valid for up to 1 (one) year from the date of publishing of the panel.

content_sections.heading: Important Dates
content_sections.text: As of 8 November 2026, the online application has not opened yet; registration starts on 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q1. How many Community Health Assistant (Urban) vacancies are there in Rampurhat Health District?
faq.answer: There are 3 posts: 1 ST post under XVFC Health Grants and 2 posts under NUHM (01 UR (PwBD), 01 UR).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Registration and fee payment close on 23 November 2026, and the final form submission closes on 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the ANM or GNM course from an Institute recognised by the Indian Nursing Council, be registered with the West Bengal Nursing Council, be proficient in Bengali and be a permanent resident of Birbhum district.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is minimum 21 years and maximum 40 years as on 1st January 2026, with age relaxation for reserved candidates as per govt. norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a Community Health Assistant (Urban)?
faq.answer: The post carries a monthly consolidated remuneration of Rs. 13,000/- (Rupees thirteen thousand only).

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The non-refundable fee is Rs.100/- for General Caste and Rs.50/- for Reserved Category, paid online through net banking, UPI or credit/debit card.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply online through www.wbhealth.gov.in: register between 13 and 23 November 2026, pay the fee, then re-login and submit the form by 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is on merit basis in the ANM/GNM examination, with marks calculated after rounding off up to 2 decimal points.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from outside Birbhum district apply?
faq.answer: The essential criteria require the candidate to be a permanent resident of Birbhum district, and the general information also requires permanent residence of West Bengal.

faq.question: Q10. Is the Community Health Assistant (Urban) post permanent?
faq.answer: The post is contractual, and the selection panel will be valid for up to 1 (one) year from the date of publishing of the panel.
